 and Anr.]
 ______________________________________________________________________
 Office Notes, Office Memoranda of Coram,
 appearances, Court's orders of directions Court's or Judge's or
 and Registrar's orders.
 Mr V. R. Thote, Advocate for the Applicants.
 Ms M. H. Deshmukh, Addl. P. P. for the Non-Applicant No.
 Coram : Vinay Joshi And Valmiki Sa Menezes, Jj.
 Date : 15th February, 2023.

The Applicants who are parents-in-law of informant seeks to quash the First Information Report (FIR) in Crime No.344 of 2022, registered with Hudkeshwar Police Station, District Nagpur, for the offence punishable under Section 498A read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.
3.
It is submitted that the entire allegations are against the husband of the informant.
The only allegation about monetary demand is vague, and therefore, does not constitute an offence.
4. Issue notice to the Non-Applicants, returnable after four weeks.

The learned Additional Public Prosecutor waives notice on behalf of Non-Applicant No.1/State.
5.
In the meantime, investigation shall go on but charge- sheet shall not be filed without obtaining leave of this Court.
(VALMIKI SA MENEZES, J.) (V Digitally Signed By:ASHISH TAMBE ASHOKRAO TAMBE Pralhad S/O Laxman Gomkar And Another vs State Of Mha.T Hr. Pso Ps Hudkeshwar ...
